The documents only directly show one of Barrichello's teammates: **Michael Schumacher**. Document [6] (2000 European Grand Prix) lists both of them at Ferrari, and Schumacher won the drivers' championship in 2000 and in the following years.

Outside the provided documents, Jenson Button was also Barrichello's teammate at Honda (2006–2008) and Brawn (2009), and he won the 2009 title. The documents don't cover that, so it's from my own knowledge.

ANSWER: Michael Schumacher, Jenson Button
